objective: Comprobar en SQL READ ONLY si el DEDICATED_MIGRATION_WRITER materializo en Desarrollo la migracion 20260910_003_catalogo_ampliado_notifications_config.sql. Certificar existencia exacta de provider configs, templates y module configs de Catalogo Ampliado para EMAIL/WHATSAPP antes de cualquier canary externo.

queries.name: identity_guard
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS DbName,SUSER_SNAME() AS LoginName,USER_NAME() AS UserName

queries.name: catalogo_ampliado_provider_configs
queries.sql: SELECT Id,MongoId,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') AS Canal,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider') AS Provider,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.token_ref') AS TokenRef FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND ((JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal')='email' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider')='smtp') OR (JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal')='whatsapp' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider')='twilio')) ORDER BY Canal,Provider

queries.name: catalogo_ampliado_templates
queries.sql: SELECT Id,MongoId,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') AS Canal,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.codigo') AS Codigo,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.version') AS Version FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.codigo')='catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') IN ('email','whatsapp') ORDER BY Canal

queries.name: catalogo_ampliado_module_configs
queries.sql: SELECT Id,MongoId,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') AS Canal,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modulo') AS Modulo,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.evento') AS Evento,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider') AS Provider,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modo_envio') AS ModoEnvio,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.template_codigo') AS TemplateCodigo,JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.max_reintentos') AS MaxReintentos FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modulo')='catalogo_ampliado' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.evento')='DOCUMENTO_VENCIMIENTO' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') IN ('email','whatsapp') ORDER BY Canal

queries.name: catalogo_ampliado_exact_counts
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND ((JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal')='email' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider')='smtp') OR (JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal')='whatsapp' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider')='twilio')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ProviderRows,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.codigo')='catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') IN ('email','whatsapp') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TemplateRows,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modulo')='catalogo_ampliado' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.evento')='DOCUMENTO_VENCIMIENTO' AND JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') IN ('email','whatsapp') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ModuleConfigRows FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1

constraints: Expected minimum canonical materialization: 2 provider rows, 2 template rows, 2 module config rows
EMAIL module config must be smtp real
WHATSAPP module config must be twilio real
